purpose: Teach: 爽快/ババ/チカ/取り込み/近かっ/つらく/こぎ/じゃう

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、運動後の爽快感、最高だね、テニスやってよかった。
lines.en: Riku, you know? That rush after exercise — tennis was totally worth it.
lines.style: Bright and energized, riding the high of the moment. Quick attack, conversational pace. The kind of enthusiasm that invites him in, not pushes.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。じいちゃんと、ババ抜き、よくやったよ、お盆。
lines.en: Yeah. Grandpa and I played Old Maid a lot during Obon. Good times.
lines.style: Softer now, pulled inward a little. Warm memory underneath. Quiet cadence. Slight pause before the trailing acceptance — not dismissing the thought, just letting it settle.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 教室の蛍光灯、チカチカして、気になるよね。
lines.en: The fluorescent lights in the classroom, they flicker kind of constantly. Gets to you, doesn't it?
lines.style: Observational, thinking out loud. Slower pace, slightly searching — like she's noticing it in real time. Gentle tone, not complaining, just aware.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活、いま、取り込み中だから、また話そうな。
lines.en: I've got club stuff piling up right now, so let's pick this up later, yeah?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not cold. A little apologetic underneath — he's redirecting but knows she gets it. Efficient delivery, one foot out the door already.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昔の小学校、家から近かったよね、お前と私。
lines.en: Our old elementary school was pretty close to home, wasn't it? For both of us.
lines.style: Nostalgic, pulling at something shared. Soft opening, slower cadence. Gentle emphasis on the 'both of us' — testing whether he remembers the same thing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: テスト、つらくなる時期だな、もうすぐ。
lines.en: Yeah, tests are going to start getting rough soon though.
lines.style: Dry acknowledgment, almost wry. Quick and grounded. No energy spent on drama — just stating the inevitable with a slight rueful smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夏休み、ボートこぎ、皆でやりたいね、湖で。
lines.en: Summer break — we should all go out on the lake and row together, right?
lines.style: Lighter, pulling him back. Eager but not desperate. Quick pace, genuine invitation. The suggestion of something he hasn't said no to yet.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 宿題、放っといて、漫画、読んじゃうよな、結局、俺たち。
lines.en: Homework sits there and we end up just reading manga anyway. That's just how it goes for us.
lines.style: Self-aware and slightly rueful. Knowing smile underneath. Accepting the pattern they're both in. Matter-of-fact pace, almost conspiratorial — like he knows this and she's saying it out loud for both of them.
